Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Card states some curation steps: random JPEG compression in pre-training; square-averaging re-weighting of NTP loss; SFT reasoning data built by InternVL3-78B describing images then DeepSeek-R1 sampling rollouts, with rollouts with an incorrect final answer filtered out.
quotes: The random JPEG compression is also included to enhance the model's real-world performance.
Rollouts with an incorrect final answer are filtered out.
To construct such data, we first use InternVL3-78B to describe the image and then input the description into DeepSeek-R1 to sample rollouts with detailed reasoning processes.
